newsitem.title: JAPAN: NEC sees larger semiconductor output in 97/98 /RPT.
newsitem.headline: NEC sees larger semiconductor output in 97/98 /RPT.

text.p: NEC Corp said on Tuesday that it expected its semiconductor output in fiscal 1997/98, ending on March 31, 1998, to rise 18 percent year-on-year to 1.3 trillion yen.
Its actual semiconductor output fell six percent to 1.1 trillion yen in 1996/97, NEC said.
NEC plans 190 billion yen in capital investment in semiconductor operations in 1997/98, unchanged from its actual investment in 1996/97.
